subject.summary: Pharmacy technicians (O*NET 29-2052.00) prepare medication under pharmacist direction, and may measure, mix, count, label, and record drug quantities and doses, receive prescriptions, and maintain patient medication records and drug storage. Prescription appropriateness judgment, final release, and individual medication counselling are the responsibility of an authorized pharmacist under local law and organizational policy.
